name: dsh-plugin-harness-cli
description: Generate and validate Harness project configuration: AGENTS.md, gates, specs, progress, and business wiki.

interface.longDescription: Install a shared Harness workflow for AGENTS.md, environment and gate scripts, feature scope, state files, DDD/SDD/TDD task docs, progress pages, database design with ER diagrams, and business-facing wiki documents. The plugin exposes the same 14 harness_cli_* tools in Codex and DSH.
